$comment: Files no single tab may edit freely. changeRule is enforced by review, ownership by governance/tools/check-file-ownership.ps1.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Append inside the tab's own marked region only; ONE registration extension method per platform; never reorder another tab's block.
sharedFiles.reason: Every tab registers services; unmarked edits collide on every change. AddCrossBusinessReporting is the pattern.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Add DbSets in the tab's marked region; never reorder; never reformat.
sharedFiles.reason: 245 DbSets; whole-file edits guarantee conflicts.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Package and analyzer references by request only.
sharedFiles.reason: A reference change alters every tab's build.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Project additions by request only.
sharedFiles.reason: Project GUIDs conflict destructively.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Our keys only via git plumbing; never whole-file git add.
sharedFiles.reason: Files are reordered by other work; whole-file staging loses keys.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Partial insertion by request; the partial must exist or every screen breaks.
sharedFiles.reason: Shared layouts already embed cross-tab partials.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Claim a SliceId in the registry before authoring; regenerate manifest.json via scan-sql-manifest.ps1.
sharedFiles.reason: D-38 names this the canonical authored root; the manifest tooling lives beside it.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Generated artifacts and operational scripts only - NOT an authoring root after D-38.
sharedFiles.reason: deploy/sql/fresh is generated by gen_fresh_db.ps1; backup and purge are operational.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Never hand-edit; regenerate with scan-sql-manifest.ps1.
sharedFiles.reason: The file says so itself; a hand-edit desynchronises hashes from content.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Reserve the number in the ADR registry before writing.
sharedFiles.reason: ADR numbers are sparse; collisions are silent.

sharedFiles.changeRule: FROZEN in this increment. Changes only through the D-37 approved visual rollout.
sharedFiles.reason: A global override flip would restyle 327 views with no design review.

sharedFiles.changeRule: No change without pre-coordination with the owner.
sharedFiles.reason: The single GL writer; already kernel-wired once without coordination.

sharedFiles.changeRule: No change without pre-coordination with the owner.
sharedFiles.reason: The single stock writer.

sharedFiles.owner: Module workflow - TAB-6 narrow read handoff
sharedFiles.changeRule: TAB-6 may ADD read-only pending-approval readers only. The approver chain, CreateAsync, DecideAsync, approval-step writes, notifications and escalation are module-owned and must not change.
sharedFiles.reason: Carries the leave approver company boundary (87ec8fa). A read contract is needed by the cross-silo inbox, but the workflow itself is not TAB-6's to alter.

sharedFiles.owner: Module workflow - TAB-6 narrow read handoff
sharedFiles.changeRule: TAB-6 may ADD read-only pending-approval readers only. CreateAsync, DecideAsync, workflow transitions, approval writes and notification logic are module-owned and must not change.
sharedFiles.reason: Shares the approver chain with leave, including its defect guard. Same narrow read need, same restriction.

sharedFiles.owner: Integration Owner - approved shared governance infrastructure
sharedFiles.changeRule: Never hand-edit. Change the canonical dataset in docs/roadmap-v2/_generator and regenerate; every edit needs explicit owner approval (-AllowShared) and must preserve machine-enforced ownership semantics.
sharedFiles.reason: These registries ARE the ownership rules the checker reads. TAB-1 owns governance/** as integration owner, but shared is evaluated BEFORE ownership, so keeping them shared forces an explicit approval on every edit instead of letting the tab that owns the rules change the rules unremarked.

sharedFiles.owner: Integration Owner - approved shared governance infrastructure
sharedFiles.changeRule: Changes require explicit owner approval (-AllowShared) and must not weaken the ownership checker or its exit codes.
sharedFiles.reason: The enforcement tooling itself. A tab that could silently relax check-file-ownership.ps1 could grant itself any path.

sharedFiles.changeRule: No change without pre-coordination with the owner.
sharedFiles.reason: The single outbox writer; the per-consumer fan-out is decided here, so one edit changes what every consumer ever sees.

sharedFiles.owner: Module surface - integration owner unblock only
sharedFiles.changeRule: Company-context remediation of named read paths only. No posting, stock, journal, receivable or payment behaviour may change under this entry.
sharedFiles.reason: Invoice read paths still resolve company from a compile-time constant while the product surface above them is company-scoped; the legacy business modules have no tab, so the screens cannot be fixed by their owner.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Shared by three committed document views; changes require owner approval (-AllowShared).
sharedFiles.reason: Three committed views include this partial and it was never committed, so a clean checkout throws partial-not-found on both invoice detail screens and the work order screen.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Shared document comments widget; changes require owner approval (-AllowShared).
sharedFiles.reason: The committed Inventory/QuotationDetails view includes this partial and it was never committed, so a clean checkout throws partial-not-found on the quotation screen.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Schema slice for a table committed product code queries; changes require owner approval (-AllowShared).
sharedFiles.reason: ProjectsAccessService queries dbo.ProjectMembers but the DDL that creates it was never committed, so a fresh deployment has no such table.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Includes the shared _EntityConversation panel and must name its own two conversation endpoints; the partial resolves none on a caller's behalf. Accounting feature work and Platform contract changes both land here, so changes require owner approval (-AllowShared).
sharedFiles.reason: The conversation endpoints used to be hardcoded inside the shared partial as Url.Action of an Accounting action, so any second module including it posted to the Accounting controller. Moving them to the caller binds this view to a shared platform contract that a tab other than the Accounting owner maintains.

sharedFiles.reason: The conversation endpoints used to be hardcoded inside the shared partial as Url.Action of an Accounting action, so any second module including it posted to the Accounting controller. Moving them to the caller binds this view to a shared platform contract that a tab other than the Accounting owner maintains.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Includes the shared _EntityConversation panel and must name its own two conversation endpoints; the partial resolves none on a caller's behalf. Inventory feature work and Platform contract changes both land here, so changes require owner approval (-AllowShared).
sharedFiles.reason: Same contract as SHF-23/24 on the invoice views. This screen was the last one rendering the legacy _DocTimeline widget into DocComments; converging it onto the Communication Platform binds an Inventory view to a shared platform contract that the Inventory owner does not maintain.

sharedFiles.changeRule: Communication conversation endpoints for Inventory-owned documents only (QuotationConversation, QuotationConversationAdd) and their shared gate. No stock, pricing, procurement, warehouse, approval or costing behaviour may change under this entry.
sharedFiles.reason: The quotation conversation must be authorized by the module that owns the document rather than routed through AccountingController, so the endpoints live here; but the file is the Inventory module surface and is not TAB-3 work. Narrow entry mirroring SHF-19 rather than transferring a 2900-line controller.

sharedFiles.owner: Integration Owner - mixed HR / organisation administration surface
sharedFiles.changeRule: HR Phase-1 sections ONLY. TAB-2 may modify the holiday, attendance, final-settlement, HR document and contract, leave accrual/encashment/carry-over/provision, leave type and leave policy, salary policy, attendance policy and employee actions (HolidaysList..DeleteHoliday, Attendance..SaveAttendance, FinalSettlement, PostFinalSettlement, HrDocuments..DeleteDocument, DocExpiryAlerts, NotifyExpiring, LeaveAccrual..SaveLeaveTypeEncashable, Polices..GetPolicy, EmployeesList, EmployeeData, GetPolicies, GetEmployeeByUserId, SaveEmployee). It may NOT modify the organisation-administration actions on the same file: JobTitlesList, GetJobTitles, JobTitle, GetBranches, GetCompanies, AdministrativeBodiesCompanyList, AdministrativeBodiesCompany, AdministrativeStructure, GetHierarchicals, AddHierarchicalItem, GetParentInfo, Index. AddHierarchicalItem WRITES a node into dbo.Hierarchicals, which carries no CompanyID and is one tree shared by every company, so it is organisation administration and not HR. Changes require owner approval (-AllowShared).
sharedFiles.reason: 1064 lines carrying two different surfaces. Roughly two thirds is HR - holidays, attendance, final settlement, HR documents, contracts, leave accrual and policies, salary and attendance policy, employees - but the rest administers companies, branches, job titles and the administrative hierarchy, which is org administration and not HR. Handing the whole file to the HR implementer as ownership would transfer company and branch administration with it, so the file stays shared and the rule names the exact HR actions instead. The three sibling partials (Appraisals, Recruitment, Training) are 100 percent HR and are narrow TAB-2 ownership rather than shared.

sharedFiles.owner: Integration Owner - shared development seed harness
sharedFiles.changeRule: Seed data for a tab's OWN feature only, appended as its own block. A tab may add the rows its feature needs and adjust the seed calls that construct them; it may not restructure the harness, reorder another tab's block, or change seed data belonging to a module it does not own. Changes require owner approval (-AllowShared).
sharedFiles.reason: 15,000 lines that every module extends as it lands, and the evidence is live rather than theoretical: at the time of this entry the file carried 283 uncommitted lines from one tab while another tab's batch was adding 32 more to a different region. Granting it to whichever tab touched it last would hand that tab every other module's seed data; leaving it unclaimed fails -Strict for everyone. Shared with a narrow per-feature rule is what it actually is.
